dataset: EPA GHG Inventory Guidance: Direct Fugitive Emissions from Refrigeration, Air Conditioning, Fire Suppression, and Industrial Gases
publisher: U.S. EPA Center for Corporate Climate Leadership
edition_note: The URL's path says 2020-12, but the PDF it serves is the December 2023 edition. In that edition the refrigeration and A/C screening factors are Table 1 (page 11); the board's "EPA Table 3" is the earlier edition's numbering. The values are the 2006 IPCC Tier 2 defaults as refined in 2019 (the table's own source line).
transcription_note: Transcribed by hand from the PDF's text; backend/tests/services/calc_trace/test_calc_trace_fugitive_screening.py checks every number against this file. EPA prints one value per factor, the upper end of the IPCC range (page 10: 'it is recommended that the upper end of the ranges be used'). The IPCC ranges themselves are not printed in this guidance, so none is recorded here; the capacity range is printed, for reference only (EPA: use the equipment's actual capacity).

equations.T: time in years used during the reporting period (e.g., 0.5 if used only during half of the reporting period and then disposed)

refrigeration.table: Table 1: Default Emission Factors for Refrigeration/Air Conditioning Equipment
refrigeration.source_line: 2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Chapter 7, Table 7.9

rows.label: Industrial refrigeration including food processing and cold storage
Residential and commercial A/C including heat pumps

fire_suppression.source_line: As provided in the Inventory of U.S. Greenhouse Gas Emissions and Sinks
fire_suppression.note: Capacity × the rate, per gas: 'Emissions from fixed systems are assumed to be 2.5 percent (0.025) of the total capacity of the units for each gas. Emissions from portable equipment are assumed to be 3.5 percent (0.035)'. No installation or disposal factor is given for fire suppression.

capacity_note: Capacity ranges are written with an en dash throughout; the PDF prints some with a hyphen (0.5-100, 5-6,500, 10-30, 4-18, 0.5-2).

ipcc_ranges.dataset: 2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 3, Chapter 7: Emissions of Fluorinated Substitutes for Ozone Depleting Substances
ipcc_ranges.table: Table 7.9 (Updated): Default estimates for charge, lifetime and emission factors for refrigeration and air-conditioning systems
ipcc_ranges.symbols: IPCC k = EPA k, IPCC x = EPA x, IPCC p (initial charge remaining) = EPA y, IPCC ηrec,d (recovery efficiency) = EPA z. k and x are printed with ≤, p and ηrec,d with < (0 < ηrec,d < 70): each is recorded here as [lower, upper] in percent.
ipcc_ranges.note: EPA's value is the upper end of each range (EPA guidance page 10). Table 7.9 prints operating-loss ranges for maritime (20–40), railway (5–20) and other MAC (10–20); none is printed for buses, so the buses x range is null.
